title: Now Hiring: English–Cantonese Speaking Certified HHA/PCA – Work Across 4 NYC Boroughs!
description:
Now Hiring: English–Cantonese Speaking Certified HHA/PCA – Work Across 4 NYC Boroughs!


We're currently hiring certified Home Health Aides (HHA) and Personal Care Aides (PCA) who are bilingual in English and Cantonese to join our growing team!

If you're compassionate, reliable, and flexible, we want to work with you. You'll have the opportunity to assist patients across Manhattan, Bronx, Brooklyn, and Queens with flexible scheduling options.

If you are interested or curious about the job details, please apply directly or send your resume to Cristina Ariola at cristina.ariola@alvitacare.com.


COMPANY OVERVIEW:

Alvita Care is a mission-driven Home Healthcare & Personal Care Agency with four branches and over 500 caregivers. We provide relief and assurance to family members in the areas of In-Home Personal Care, Alzheimer's & Dementia Care, Palliative & Hospice Care, and Geriatric Care Management and have earned The Joint Commission Gold Seal of Approval. Alvita Care clients are all private-pay and we do not accept Medicare or Medicaid.

As we expand our circle of care, we are seeking top-notch caregivers to service our Connecticut needs across the five boroughs. We have private-duty one-on-one care cases available as well as facility-based care cases.

All applicants are subject to a phone screening to determine compatibility and overall availability of accommodations for both the caregiver and the agency. Please note that cases with Alvita Care are only available to caregivers who successfully complete the onboarding process.


QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Valid HHA/PCA certification in the state of NY.
  • Bilingual – English and Cantonese required
  • At least 1 Year of experience as private care.
  • Able to work within Manhattan, Bronx, Brooklyn, and Queens
  • Reliable, punctual, and caring attitude
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure and handle challenging behaviors with care
  • Trustworthy, reliable, and compassionate
  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Memory Care, Palliative, ADL, and transfer experience are all a plus

DETAILS:
  • Full-time, part-time, & per diem schedule options are available
  • 6 - 12 hour day time shifts available; overnights available occasionally
  • Weekend availability and flexibility with shifts
  • Supportive and respectful work environment
  • Pay ranges from $20.00-21.00/hourly
  • Weekly paycheck on Fridays (direct deposit, debit pay card, or paper check)

    Some Additional benefits to look forward to:
  • Medical / health benefits available*
  • Sick time – up to 56 hours per year of sick time per year based on hours worked
  • 401(k) with company match **
  • Fast onboarding process to get you working ASAP
* subject to one-year employment and 1,560 hours worked (30 hours / week average)
** - subject to one-year employment and 1,000 hours worked (20 hour
